notes: Utica Boilers; page lists ECR among sister/similar brands. The page's ECR quick-reference section is deliberately NOT imported (own-page rule; watch item). styles.notes: Page: work week = 1st-2nd character numerical digits, year = 3rd-4th character numerical digits, converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example 160500150 decodes week 16, year 2005.
